name: ASTRO
recent: Astro 正推进以最高 RM83 million 向 Maxis Broadband 出售其宽带业务资产，并已发出股东通函，将于 2026 年 12 月 3 日召开 EGM 寻求批准。同期公司公布截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日季度业绩，营收同比下滑且录得净亏损。
notable: MEASAT Broadcast Network Systems Sdn Bhd, a wholly-owned subsidiary, entered into a conditional sale and purchase agreement with Maxis Broadband Sdn Bhd to dispose of broadband business assets for a cash consideration of up to RM83.0 million.。
The company issued a circular to shareholders and a notice of extraordinary general meeting for 3 December 2026 to approve the proposed disposal.。
There were changes in boardroom and board committees, including the appointment of MR RENZO CHRISTOPHER VIEGAS and changes involving PUAN CHOW MEI MEI and MR PRASHANT KUMAR.。
risks: The proposed disposal is subject to shareholder approval at the EGM on 3 December 2026.。
The company recorded a net loss of RM25.8 million for the quarter ended 31 July 2026.。
A winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator announcement was made on 30 October 2026.。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日季度，营收为 RM633.8 million，环比下降 3.9%，同比下降 7.2%；净亏损为 RM25.8 million，净利率为 -4.1%，上季度净利率为 0.2%。

recent_en: Astro is proceeding with the disposal of its broadband business assets to Maxis Broadband for up to RM83 million and has issued a shareholder circular for an EGM on 3 December 2026 to seek approval. In the same period, the company reported quarterly results for the period ended 31 July 2026, with revenue declining year-on-year and a net loss recorded.
notable_en: MEASAT Broadcast Network Systems Sdn Bhd, a wholly-owned subsidiary, entered into a conditional sale and purchase agreement with Maxis Broadband Sdn Bhd to dispose of broadband business assets for a cash consideration of up to RM83.0 million.
The company issued a circular to shareholders and a notice of extraordinary general meeting for 3 December 2026 to approve the proposed disposal.
There were changes in boardroom and board committees, including the appointment of MR RENZO CHRISTOPHER VIEGAS and changes involving PUAN CHOW MEI MEI and MR PRASHANT KUMAR.
risks_en: The proposed disposal is subject to shareholder approval at the EGM on 3 December 2026.
The company recorded a net loss of RM25.8 million for the quarter ended 31 July 2026.
A winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator announcement was made on 30 October 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was RM633.8 million, down 3.9% QoQ and 7.2% YoY; net loss was RM25.8 million with a net margin of -4.1%, compared with a net margin of 0.2% in the previous quarter.
